description: This victory belongs to the people of the 7th Congressional District. In a race shaped by millions in outside spending, we proved that a campaign powered by people can stand on its own and win. I am accountable to you, not to special interests, and I am committed to representing every community in this district, including those who did not support me. Your voice matters, and you have a seat at the table.
paid_for_by: Paid for by La Shawn K
title: A Letter to the People of the 7th Congressional District - Ford for Congress
